ja538:1.1: Mā paṇḍicciyaṃ vibhāvaya, bālamato bhava sabbapāṇinaṃ. sabbo taṃ jano ocināyatu, evaṃ tava attho bhavissatīti.
ja538:2.1: Karomi te taṃ vacanaṃ yaṃ maṃ bhaṇasi devate, atthakāmāsi me amma hitakāmāsi devate
ja538:3.1: ti imaṃ g. vatvā Kin nu santaramāno va kāsuṃ khaṇasi sārathi, puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, kiṃ kāsuyā karissasīti.
ja538:4.1: Rañño mūgo ca pakkho ca putto jāto acetaso, so 'mhi raññā samijjhiṭṭho puttaṃ me nikhaṇaṃ vane ti.
ja538:5.1: Na badhiro na mūgo 'smi na pakkho na pi paṅgulo, adhammaṃ sārathi kayirā maṃ ce tvaṃ nikhaṇaṃ vane.
ja538:6.1: Ūruṃ bāhuñ ca me passa, bhāsitañ ca suṇohi me, adhammaṃ sārathi kayirā maṃ ce tvaṃ nikhaṇaṃ vane ti.
ja538:7.1: Devatā nu si gandhabbo adu Sakko purindado, ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan ti.
ja538:8.1: N' amhi devo na gandhabbo na pi Sakko purindado, (Petavatthu p. 24.) Kāsirañño ahaṃ putto yaṃ kāsuyā nighaññasi.
ja538:9.1: Tassa rañño ahaṃ putto yaṃ tvaṃ samupajīvasi, adhammaṃ sārathi kayirā maṃ ce tvaṃ nikhaṇaṃ vane.
ja538:10.1: Yassa rukkhassa chāyāya nisīdeyya sayeyya vā (= J. vol. V. 340|21, Petavatthu p. 23.) na tassa sākhaṃ bhañjeyya, mittadūbho hi pāpako.
ja538:11.1: Yathā rukkho tathā rājā, yathā sākhā tathā ahaṃ, yathā chāyūpago poso evaṃ tvam asi sārathi, adhammaṃ sārathi kayirā maṃ ce tvaṃ nikhaṇaṃ vane ti.
ja538:12.1: Pahūtabhakkho bhavati vippavuttho sakā gharā, (Cfr. Feer in Journal Asiatique Tome p. 248.) bahū naṃ upajīvanti yo mittānaṃ na dūbhati.
ja538:13.1: Yaṃ yaṃ janapadaṃ yāti nigame rājadhāniyo sabbattha pūjito hoti yo mittānaṃ na dūbhati.
ja538:14.1: Nāssa corā pasahanti nātimaññeti khattiyo sabbe amitte tarati yo mittānaṃ na dūbhati.
ja538:15.1: Akuddho sagharaṃ eti sabhāya paṭinandito ñātīnaṃ uttamo hoti yo mittānaṃ na dūbhati.
ja538:16.1: Sakkatvā sakkato hoti garu hoti sagāravo vaṇṇakittibhato hoti yo mittānaṃ na dūbhati.
ja538:17.1: Pūjako labhate pūjaṃ vandako paṭivandanaṃ yaso kittiñ ca pappoti yo mittānaṃ na dūbhati.
ja538:18.1: Aggi yathā pajjalati devatā va virocati siriyā ajahito hoti yo mittānam na dūbhati.
ja538:19.1: Gāvo tassa pajāyanti khette vuttaṃ virūhati vuttānaṃ phalam asanāti yo mittānaṃ na dūbhati.
ja538:20.1: Darito pabbatāto vā rukkhato patito naro cuto patiṭṭhaṃ labhati yo mittānaṃ na {dūbhati}.
ja538:21.1: Virūḷhamūlasantānaṃ nigrodham iva māḷuto amittā na-ppasahanti yo mittānaṃ na dūbhati.
ja538:22.1: Ehi taṃ paṭinessāmi rājaputta sakaṃ gharaṃ, rajjaṃ kārehi, bhaddan te, kiṃ araññe karissasīti.
ja538:23.1: Alam me tena rajjena ñātakehi dhanena vā yam me adhammacariyāya rajjaṃ labbhetha sārathīti.
ja538:24.1: Puṇṇapattaṃ palabbhehi rājaputta ito gato, pitā mātā ca me dajjuṃ rājaputta tayi gate.
ja538:25.1: Orodhā ca kumārā ca vesiyānā ca brāhmaṇā te pi attamanā dajjuṃ rājaputta tayi gate.
ja538:26.1: Hatthārūhā anīkaṭṭhā rathikā pattikārikā te pi dajjuṃ patītā me rājaputta tayi gate.
ja538:27.1: Bahū janapadā c' aññe negamā ca samagatā upāyanāni me dajjuṃ rājaputta tayi gate.
ja538:28.1: Pitu mātuc c' ahaṃ catto rathassa nigamassa ca atho sabbakumārānaṃ, n' atthi mayhaṃ sakaṃ gharaṃ.
ja538:29.1: Anuññāto ahaṃ matyā, saṃcatto pitarā ahaṃ, eko araññe pabbajito, na kāme abhipatthaye ti.
ja538:30.1: Api ataramānānaṃ phalāsā va samijjhati, (J. vol. I p. vipakkabrahmacariyo 'smi, evaṃ jānāhi sārathi.
ja538:31.1: Api ataramānānaṃ sammadattho vipaccati, vipakkabrahmacariyo 'smi nikkhanto akutobhayo ti.
ja538:32.1: Evaṃ vaggukatho santo vissatthavacano c' asi, kasmā pituc ca mātuc ca santike na bhaṇī tadā ti.
ja538:33.1: Nāham asandhitā pakkho na badhiro asotatā, nāhaṃ ajivhatā mūgo, mā maṃ mūgam. adhārayi.
ja538:34.1: Purimaṃ sarām' ahaṃ jātiṃ yattha rajjam akārayiṃ, kārayitvā tahiṃ rajjaṃ pāpatthaṃ nirayaṃ bhusaṃ.
ja538:35.1: Vīsatiṃ c' eva vassāni tahiṃ rajjam akārayiṃ, {asītivassasahassāni} nirayamhi apaccayiṃ.
ja538:36.1: Tassa rajjass' aham bhīto mā maṃ rajj' abhisecayuṃ, tasmā pituc ca mātuc ca santike na bhaṇiṃ tadā.
ja538:37.1: Ucchaṅge maṃ nisīdetvā pitā atth' ānusāsati: ekaṃ hanatha, bandhatha ekaṃ khārāpatacchikaṃ ekaṃ sūlasmiṃ accetha, icc-assa-m-anusāsati.
ja538:38.1: Tassāhaṃ pharusaṃ sutvā vācāyo samudīritā amūgo mūgavaṇṇena apakkho pakkhasammato sake muttakarīsasmiṃ acch' āhaṃ samparipluto.
ja538:39.1: Kasirañ ca parittañ ca tañ ca dukkhena saṃyutaṃ ko taṃ jīvitam āgamma veraṃ kayirātha kenaci.
ja538:40.1: Paññāya ca alābhena dhammassa ca adassanā ko taṃ jīvitam āgamma veraṃ kayirātha kenaci.
ja538:41.1: Api ataramānānaṃ phalāsā va samijjhati, vipakkabrahmacariyo smi, evaṃ jānāhi sārathi.
ja538:42.1: Api ataramānānaṃ sammadattho vipaccati, vipakkabrahmacariyo 'smi nikkhanto akutobhayo ti.
ja538:43.1: Aham pi pabbajissāmi rājaputta tav' antike, avhayassu maṃ, bhaddan te, pabbajjā mama ruccatīti.
ja538:44.1: Rathaṃ niyyādayitvāna anaṇo ehi sārathi, anaṇassa hi pabbajjā, etaṃ isīhi vaṇṇitan ti.
ja538:45.1: Yad eva ty-āhaṃ vacanaṃ akaraṃ, bhaddam atthu te, tad eva me tvaṃ vacanaṃ yācito kattum arahasi.
ja538:46.1: Idh' eva tāva acchassu yāva rājānam ānaye, app-eva te pitā disvā patīto sumano siyā ti.
ja538:47.1: Karomi te taṃ vacanaṃ yaṃ maṃ bhaṇasi sārathi, aham pi daṭṭhukāmo 'smi pitaraṃ me idhāgataṃ.
ja538:48.1: Ehi samma nivattassu, kusalaṃ vajjāsi ñātinaṃ, mātaraṃ pitaraṃ mayhaṃ vutto vajjāsi vandanan
ja538:49.1: ti. Tassa pāde gahetvāna katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ sārathi ratham āruyha rājadvāraṃ upāgamīti.
ja538:50.1: Suññaṃ mātā rathaṃ disvā ekaṃ sārathim āgataṃ assupuṇṇehi nettehi rodantī naṃ udikkhati.
ja538:51.1: Ayaṃ so sārathi eti nihantvāna mam' atrajaṃ, nihato nūna me putto pathavyā bhūmivaddhano.
ja538:52.1: Amittā nūna nandanti patītā nūna verino āgataṃ sārathiṃ disvā nihantvāna mam' atrajaṃ.
ja538:53.1: Suññaṃ mātā rathaṃ disvā ekam sārathim āgataṃ assupuṇṇehi nettehi rodantī paripucchati: Kin
ja538:54.1: nu mūgo kin nu pakkho kin nu so vilapi tadā nihaññamāno bhūmiyā, tam me akkhāhi sārathi.
ja538:55.1: Kathaṃ hatthehi pādehi mūgapakkho vivajjayi nihaññamāno bhūmiyā, tam me akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja538:56.1: Akkhissan te ahaṃ ayye dajjāsi abhayaṃ mama yam me sutaṃ vā diṭṭhaṃ vā rājaputtassa santike ti.
ja538:57.1: Abhayaṃ samma te dammi abhīto bhaṇa sārathi yan te sutaṃ vā diṭṭhaṃ vā rājaputtassa santike ti.
ja538:58.1: Na so mūgo na so pakkho vissaṭṭhavacano ca so, rajjassa kira so bhīto akarī ālaye bahū.
ja538:59.1: Purimaṃ so sarati jātiṃ yattha rajjam akārayi kārayitvā tahiṃ rajjaṃ pāpattha nirayaṃ bhusaṃ.
ja538:60.1: Vīsatiñ c' eva vassāni tahiṃ rajjam akārayi, asītivassasahassāni nirayamhi apacci so.
ja538:61.1: Tassa rajjassa so bhīto mā maṃ rajj' abhisecayuṃ, tasmā pituc ca mātuc ca santike na bhaṇi tadā.
ja538:62.1: Aṅgapaccaṅgasampanno ārohapariṇāhavā vissaṭṭhavacano pañño magge saggassa tiṭṭhati.
ja538:63.1: Sace tvaṃ daṭṭhukāmāsi rājaputtaṃ tav' atrajaṃ ehi taṃ {pāpayissāmi} yattha sammati Temiyo ti.
ja538:64.1: Yojayantu rathe asse, kacchaṃ nāgāna bandhatha, udīrayantu saṃkhapaṇavā vadataṃ ekapokkharā.
ja538:65.1: Nadantu bherī sannaddhā vaggū vadatu dundubhi, negamā ca maṃ anventu, gacchaṃ puttanivedako.
ja538:66.1: Orodhā ca kumārā ca vesiyānā ca brāhmaṇā khippaṃ yānāni yojentu, gacchaṃ puttanivedako.
ja538:67.1: Hatthārohā anīkaṭṭhā rathikā pattikārikā khippaṃ yānāni yojentu, gacchaṃ puttanivedako.
ja538:68.1: Samāgatā janapadā negamā ca samāgatā, khippaṃ yānāni yojentu, gacchaṃ puttanivedako ti.
ja538:69.1: Asse ca sārathī yutte sindhave sīghavāhane rājadvāraṃ upagañchuṃ: yuttā deva ime hayā
ja538:70.1: ti. Thūlā javena hāyanti kisā hāyanti thāmunā ti "Evarūpe asse mā gaṇhathā" 'ti sārathiṃ vadiṃsu. Kise thūle vivajjetvā saṃsaṭṭhā yojitā hayā
ja538:71.1: ti Deva javena vaṇṇena balena ca sādisā hayā yojitā ti ā. Tato rājā taramāno {yuttamāruyha} sandanaṃ. itthāgāraṃ ajjhabhāsi: sabbā va anuyātha maṃ.
ja538:72.1: Vāḷavījanim uṇhīsaṃ khaggaṃ chattañ ca paṇḍaraṃ upādhiratham āruyha suvaṇṇena alaṃkato.
ja538:73.1: Tato ca rājā pāyāsi purakkhatvāna sārathiṃ, khippam eva upāgacchi yattha sammati Temiyo.
ja538:74.1: Tañ ca disvāna āyantaṃ jalantam iva tejasā khattasaṃghaparibbūḷhaṃ Temiyo etad abravi:
ja538:75.1: Kaccin nu tāta kusalaṃ, kacci tāta anāmayaṃ, kaccin nu rājakaññāyo ārogā mayha mātaro.
ja538:76.1: Kusalaṃ c' eva me putta, atho putta anāmayaṃ, sabbā va rājakaññāyo ārogā tuyha mātaro.
ja538:77.1: Kacci-ss-amajjapo tāta, kacci te suram appiyaṃ, kacci sacce ca dhamme ca dāne te ramatī mano.
ja538:78.1: Amajjapo ahaṃ putta, atho me suram appiyaṃ, atho sacce ca dhamme ca dāne me ramatī mano.
ja538:79.1: Kacci ārogaṃ yoggan te, kacci vahati vāhanaṃ, kacci te vyādhiyo n' atthi, sarīrass' upatāpanā.
ja538:80.1: Atho ārogaṃ yoggam me, atho vahati vāhanaṃ, atho vyādhiyo n' atthi, sarīrass' upatāpanā.
ja538:81.1: Kacci antā ca te phītā majjhe va bahalā tava, koṭṭhāgārañ ca kosañ ca kacci te paṭisanthataṃ.
ja538:83.1: Svāgatan te mahārāja, atho te adurāgataṃ, patiṭṭhāpentu pallaṃkaṃ yattha rājā nisakkatīti.
ja538:84.1: Idh' eva te nisinnassa niyate paṇṇasanthate etto udakam ādāya pāde pakkhālayanti te ti.
ja538:85.1: Idam pi paṇṇakaṃ mayhaṃ randham rāja aloṇikaṃ paribhuñja mahārāja, pāhuno me si āgato ti.
ja538:86.1: Na cāhaṃ paṇṇakaṃ bhuñje, na h' etaṃ mayha bhojanaṃ, sālīnaṃ odanaṃ bhuñje suciṃ maṃsūpasecanan ti.
ja538:87.1: Accherakammaṃ paṭibhāti ekakam pi rahogataṃ, edisaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ kena vaṇṇo pasīdatīti.
ja538:88.1: Eko rāja nipajjāmi niyate paṇṇasanthate, tāya me ekaseyyāya rāja vaṇṇo pasīdati.
ja538:89.1: Na ve nettiṃsabaddhā me rājarakkhā upaṭṭhitā, tāya me sukhaseyyāya rāja vaṇṇo pasīdati.
ja538:90.1: Atītaṃ nānusocāmi, na-ppajappām' anāgataṃ, paccuppannena yāpemi, tena vaṇṇo pasīdati.
ja538:91.1: Anāgatappajappāya atītassānusocanā etena bālā sussanti nalo va harito luto ti.
ja538:92.1: Hatthānīkaṃ rathānīkaṃ asse pattī ca vammino nivesanāni rammāni ahaṃ putta dadāmi te.
ja538:93.1: Itthāgāram pi te dammi sabbālaṃkārabhūsitaṃ, tā putta paṭipajjassu, tvaṃ no rājā bhavissasi.
ja538:94.1: Kusalā naccagītassa sikkhitā caturitthiyo kāme taṃ ramayissanti, kiṃ araññe karissasi.
ja538:95.1: Paṭirājūhi te kaññā ānayissaṃ alaṃkatā, tāsu putte janetvāna atha pacchā pabbajissasi.
ja538:96.1: Yuvā ca daharo cāsi paṭhamuppattito susu, rajjaṃ kārehi, bhaddan te, kiṃ araññe karissasīti.
ja538:97.1: Yuvā care brahmacariyaṃ, brahmacārī yuvā siyā, daharassa hi pabbajjā, etaṃ isīhi vaṇṇitaṃ.
ja538:98.1: Yuvā care brahmacariyaṃ, brahmacārī yuvā siyā, brahmacariyaṃ carissāmi, nāhaṃ rajjena-m-atthiko.
ja538:99.1: Passāmi vo 'haṃ daharaṃ ‘amma tāta' vadantaraṃ kicchā laddhaṃ piyaṃ puttaṃ appatvā va jaraṃ mataṃ.
ja538:100.1: Passāmi vo 'haṃ dahariṃ kumāriṃ cārudassaniṃ naḷavaṃsakaḷīraṃ va paluggaṃ jīvitakkhaye. Daharāpi
ja538:101.1: hi mīyanti narā ca atha nāriyo, tattha ko vissase poso daharo 'mhīti jīvite.
ja538:102.1: Yassa ratyā vivasane āyuṃ appataraṃ siyā appodake va macchānaṃ kin nu komārakaṃ tahiṃ.
ja538:103.1: Niccam abbhāhato loko niccañ ca parivārito, amoghāsu vajantīsu kiṃ maṃ rajjena siñcasi.
ja538:104.1: {Kena-m-abbhāhato} loko kena ca parivārito, kāyo amoghā gacchanti, tam me akkhāhi pucchito.
ja538:105.1: Maccun' abbhāhato loko jarāya parivārito. ratyā amoghā gacchanti, evaṃ jānāhi khattiya.
ja538:106.1: Yathāpi tante vitate yaṃ yaṃ dev' ūpavīyati appakaṃ hoti vetabbaṃ evaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ.
ja538:107.1: Yathā vārivaho pūro gacchan n' ūpanivattati evam āyu manussānaṃ gacchan n' ūpanivattati.
ja538:108.1: Yathā vārivaho pūro vahe rukkh' ūpakūlaje evaṃ jarāya maraṇena vuyhante vata pāṇino ti.
ja538:109.1: Hatthānīkaṃ rathānīkaṃ asse pattī ca vammino nivesanāni rammāni ahaṃ putta dadāmi te.
ja538:110.1: Itthāgāram pi te dammi sabbālaṃkārabhūsitaṃ. tā putta paṭipajjassu, tvaṃ no rājā bhavissasi.
ja538:111.1: {Kusalā} naccagītassa sikkhitā caturitthiyo kāme taṃ ramayissanti, kiṃ araññe karissasi.
ja538:112.1: Paṭirājūhi te kaññā ānayissaṃ alaṃkatā, tāsu putte janetvāna atha pacchā pabbajissasi.
ja538:114.1: Koṭṭhāgārañ ca kosañ ca vāhanāni balāni ca nivesanāni rammāni ahaṃ putta dadāmi te.
ja538:115.1: Gomaṇḍalaparibbūḷho dāsasaṃghapurakkhato rajjaṃ kārehi, bhaddan te, kim araññe karissasīti.
ja538:116.1: Kiṃ dhanena yaṃ jiyyetha, kiṃ bhariyāya marissati, kiṃ yobbanena ciṇṇena yaṃ jarā abhihessati.
ja538:117.1: Tattha kā nandi kā khiḍḍā kā rati kā dhanesanā, kim me puttehi dārehi, rāja mutto 'smi bandhanā.
ja538:118.1: So 'haṃ evaṃ pajānāmi: maccu me na-ppamajjati, antakenādhipannassa kā rati kā dhanesanā.
ja538:119.1: Phalānam iva pakkānaṃ niccaṃ papatanā bhayaṃ (vol. IV p. 127.) evaṃ jātānaṃ maccānaṃ niccaṃ maraṇato bhayaṃ.
ja538:120.1: Sāyam eke na dissanti, pāto diṭṭhā bahujjanā, pāto eke na dissanti, sāyaṃ diṭṭhā bahujjanā.
ja538:121.1: Ajj' eva kiccaṃ ātappaṃ, ko jaññā maraṇaṃ suve, na hi no saṃgaran tena mahāsenena maccunā.
ja538:122.1: Corā dhanassa patthenti, rāja mutto smi bandhanā, ehi rāja nivattassu, nāhaṃ rajjena-m-atthiko ti.
